articles.title: FOURTH SURVEY VESSEL (LARGE) 'SANSHODHAK' DELIVERED TO INDIAN NAVY AT GRSE KOLKATA
articles.summary: The Indian Navy has inducted 'Sanshodhak,' the fourth and final Survey Vessel (Large) of its class, successfully completing a crucial four-ship project. This induction significantly boosts the Navy's hydrographic capabilities, vital for mapping oceans and coastal areas, enhancing maritime safety, and supporting naval operations. It further underscores India's growing self-reliance in advanced naval shipbuilding.

articles.title: Aatmanirbhar Bharat: MoD & BEL sign Rs 1,950 crore contract for Mountain Radars for IAF
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence highlighted ongoing efforts to strengthen India's indigenous defence capabilities under the 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' and 'Make-in-India' initiatives. This strategic focus aims to boost self-reliance in defence manufacturing, reduce import dependence, and foster innovation within the domestic industrial base. Such measures are vital for enhancing national security and achieving strategic autonomy.

articles.title: Russian An-26 crash kills 29 in Crimea #world
articles.summary: A Russian An-26 military transport aircraft crashed in Crimea after descending into a cliff, killing all 29 people aboard. Russia's Defence Ministry confirmed the incident through state media. This tragic event underscores the inherent risks associated with military aviation operations, particularly in regions like Crimea, raising questions about flight safety protocols.

articles.title: US lists India's preference for domestic satellites for DTH, localised internet shutdown as trade barrier
